name: Barbed needle battery
description: A heavy needle gun that fires thin spikes at great speed. Dark elf gunners prefer it for its quiet precision.

name: Barbed needle lance
description: A long lance of coilwork that throws a needle through armour. The Courts keep their best ones for the flagship.

name: Dirge cannon
description: A slow plasma turret that sings as it charges. It leaves a pale scar on whatever it hits.

name: Great dirge cannon
description: The largest plasma turret in Court service, salvaged and rebuilt many times over.

name: Lament laser
description: A fast, bright laser turret with an excellent reach. Its flash is pale and almost silent.

name: Shiver flak battery
description: Point defence that scatters shards into the path of fighters and missiles.

name: Quietus torpedo
description: A slow and patient torpedo. Court captains say that once it is fired the argument is over.

name: Sting missile rack
description: Small homing missiles for fighters, thin and fast.

name: Sting missile pod
description: A pod of homing missiles for gunships and fighters that want a quiet first strike.
